result:
PR #268 is still a draft, on purpose: the device test that decides it hasn't run yet.

- **Why there was no CI run:** master had changed the index file `docs/testing/nv2a_index.json` since my last merge. The PR couldn't be merged cleanly, so GitHub built nothing on `3d870930db`. The previous session ended its wait without merging master first.
- **Fix:** I merged `origin/master` (`6ea34eb27a`). The index file was the only conflict. It's a generated file, so I rebuilt it from the same pinned test and support trees the fold job uses, and its `check` passes. The commit the prediction names as its fixed side (`c2336637cf`) is still in the branch history, so the registered prediction still stands. The PR now reports MERGEABLE on head `8dfe303deb`, and CI should run on that head.
- **Definition of done:** `NOTES.md` has a Session 4 entry saying why the last session didn't finish. The PR's `Files:` line matches `git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD`, and the prediction is committed with its refs. I didn't run `preflight.sh` this session.
- **Still waiting on:** the device comparison for `wbufdepth24-d24sat.json`, which checks the D24 depth fix against master. Both of its runs are still queued (`1790371358-arms-wbufdepth24-base-50897`, `-fix-50997`). I posted a `[lane.wbufdepth24] waiting:` comment on #268 saying so.

When the verdict arrives: if it passes and CI is green on the new head, mark #268 ready. If it fails, read the per-row misses on the fixed side and check for `unreadable` captures before changing the fix.

The Base line in the PR body still names the older merge (`753feafde3`). I left it alone because `gh pr edit` doesn't work in this repo.
